claim: Dictionary definitions of presence: current existence or occurrence; the area around a great personage; a person present in an impressive way; "a person's bearing, especially when it commands respectful attention"; "the quality of self-assurance and effectiveness that permits a performer to achieve a rapport with the audience"; "the state of being in a certain place, and not in some other place", as a planet in its orbit, or near the speaker, or where his thought is directed
A few of the dictionary definitions of presence seem to touch on really important things
As defined here, presence is being fully right now in mind, body, spirit and energy together
Part of presence is the mind on the present moment, not lost in past or future thoughts, worries or daydreams

As some dictionary definitions kind of allude to, presence is really kind of more than now-ness, and there's something energetic about it: around somebody with that quality you feel a different connection, rapport and energetic charge
For most of us, most of our lives, we're very much not present a lot of the time, the mind on the past, the future, later today or an earlier conversation, and our energy split among those places
Not being present impacts every moment of every day, hugely
The more present, the more peace and power we feel, and the better we connect
The more present, the freer we are from the controlling, overwhelming feeling of negative or challenging emotions: they don't necessarily go away, but feel much less powerful
Until we start a journey of meditation and other practices and develop presence with intention, most of us have very little presence most of the time
Part of having very little presence is kind of modern society, our attention always drawn to 18 different places, messages and everything in our digital and physical world
Recognize presence very intentionally and come back to it: we don't create it, it's always with us, and other stuff gets in the way
Presence matters for living life the way we want, being effective, and connecting with people as deeply as possible

In sex, without question, presence is maybe the most important factor for experiences that are not only pleasurable but deeply connecting, alone (masturbating, edging) or with a partner: the number one factor, more important than erection quality, your weight or your looks
Present in sex, we connect with ourselves, our body and its feelings, energy and sensations, and with a partner's. It is only through being present that we make those connections

You may have had the experience, alone masturbating or having sex with a partner, where you or your partner wasn't present, and with a partner sometimes it can be quite obvious: your wife mentally moved on to the next thing in your day, or you have, or you're freaking out about the last time you couldn't get an erection

So rarely are we fully present in sex, and it makes all the difference in the world: fully connecting with the energies, sensations, bodies, emotions and spirits, yours and your partner's, is when sex becomes magic

Unfortunately, a lot of how modern society portrays sex is the opposite of presence, a very disconnected version: porn takes a big chunk of your being, mentally and energetically, off to another image, person or imagined scene

Fantasy also takes you away from presence, one reason to move away from it, ideally as much as possible, when masturbating or edging: imagining somebody, specific or generic, necessarily, by definition, takes some of the awareness away from right now
name: Sexual fantasy

claim: You can't think about a person who isn't here if your full presence is here
name: Sexual fantasy

claim: Less fantasy means better sexual experiences: certainly important in edging, so critical with a partner
name: Sexual fantasy

claim: In sex with a partner, presence matters more than anything else

Fully present with a partner, lots of things can, "quote, go wrong" (awkwardness, something funky and laughing, not quite the erection you want, losing it) and it will almost always still be a wonderful, connecting experience

Conversely, with a partner everything can "quote go right", a great erection, porn-performance kind of sex that looks "quote, right", and feel very disconnected and disempowering, a lot of times, if either of you isn't present
How to develop more presence
To develop more presence, meditation, talked about over and over because it's absolutely critical: all of us should be meditating
The benefits of meditation stretch into every aspect of life, without question into sex, with more presence in daily life and during sex
To develop more presence, mindful edging: no porn, ideally no fantasy, and ideally full awareness on what's happening in your body right now, the feelings, sensations, energy
In mindful edging, get away from the external and from wanting another scenario, and be with what is
Edging truly present versus not is light years different, with tremendous benefits even if you're single and expect a while before a partner, because of your life or your age
Mindful edging translates to sex: "practice like you want to play", talked about before
To develop more presence, move with your eyes closed, talked about before: physical training from yoga to bodyweight to kettlebells
name: Exercising with eyes closed

claim: Closing your eyes to the outer world brings you into right now, into your body, its energy and sensations
name: Exercising with eyes closed

claim: A still meditation is a great and important foundation, but moving with your eyes closed translates presence into movement, and sex involves movement
name: Exercising with eyes closed

claim: Maybe the last way, for now, to develop more presence: very intentionally bring presence into sex with a partner

Married and about to have sex with your wife, take a little time at the start, even very, very brief, to find stillness and grounding in the present moment together: before you're out of your clothes, maybe a hug, face to face, forehead resting against hers, just breathing and being for a second; or lying in bed in that stillness
Returning to your body, covered in a recent episode, is a really powerful way to presence
Grounding into your body is great alone; together with a partner before sex, it brings both of you into presence

Grounding together before sex may look different, but the idea is a little moment of stillness, connection and breathing before moving and doing all the things, which can really make a big impact on how it goes and how deeply you connect
A lot of guys struggle at times, some of you surely, with some form of kind of sexual anxiety: how you'll "quote perform", erection quality, how long you'll last

Sexual anxiety about how you'll perform, erection quality or how long you'll last takes you away from presence: fully present, you're not worried about anything, and all of those things improve with presence
For erection struggles, lots of practices address it overall, but the very best thing in the moment is to let go of the worry and just be present
name: Erection quality

claim: Found over and over, personally and working with clients: present with the sensations and energy, everything gets better, feeling, erections, arousal management, lasting longer with better control, connection with yourself and your partner
Frankly, the same goes for life as for sex: present, everything gets better
Being more present is one of the fundamental things that has really changed the experience and the course of life
We're never going to be 100% present all of the time; we all get pulled out occasionally
Most of us start from almost never really being present and gradually bring presence into more of our day, life and sexual experiences
The more we tap into presence, the more we stay and the easier it is to come back, and everything gets better, without question sex too
Before sex, presence is what helps your partner feel connected with you, safe, secure and attracted, and you with them

Being fully present, not lost in some thought, worry or unprocessed emotion, is the greatest gift you can give somebody in that moment, a friend, a date, your wife, and the most powerful way to connect: on a date, with someone at the gym or the store you want to ask out, with your wife

As in the dictionary definitions of presence as bearing and as a performer's rapport: connecting with a date, a wife or a friend isn't a performance, but fully present, you establish rapport, with greater charisma and connection
Being aware of your presence, practicing it and making it a priority has such a tremendous return on investment: it changes how life feels, how you function, connect and have sex, no question

We all have to do the work: sometimes the gym, mental work like writing or a project, the conversation you need to have, being vulnerable, or inner work on your relationship with yourself and how you are being in the world. It changes everything
name: Discipline and intention

claim: "Be present" can sound like trite or hollow words to some of you

Feel presence as an experience and you know it can make life feel very different: sometimes after a couple, a few weeks or a month of meditation, plus regular mindful edging, eyes-closed movement and grounding into your body
Feeling presence as an experience, you also notice times you're very much not present, caught up in some other place or time
As soon as you realize you're not present, in a lot of ways you're present again, in the observer spot
The journey of presence: pulled out, realizing it, coming back, again and again, and over time you spend more and more time present

There is probably nothing with a greater impact on your relationships, and on how fulfilling and deeply connecting sex is, than building your presence: you connect with people, your partner and yourself differently
Building presence is work absolutely worth doing, with habits: meditation, and another really good one not mentioned in a while, cold showers
Of the cold shower's lots of benefits, one is this sort of quiet place of presence: it's nearly impossible to stand in one thinking about bills, a project, a house chore or yesterday's screw-up
In a cold shower, you're just right now, with that sensation
Each cold shower helps carry the quality of presence into the day, encounters with people, and certainly sex
Do the inner work, the outer work, all the work: sit down, be still, and get after it for your mental health, finding that place of presence
